summary.text: Steve Luking is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican Sam Page.
A retired family physician from Reidsville, he also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Steve Luking was born in Dayton, Ohio, earned a bachelor's degree from Wright State University in 1980 and an M.D. from the University of Cincinnati in 1984, and also graduated from the University of South Carolina in 1987.
He works as a physician and co-founded Reidsville Family Medicine in 1993.
He served as chief of staff and chairperson of the hospital board at Annie Penn Hospital and became a member of the American Academy of Family Physicians in 1984.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he lived and practiced in Roxboro for four years and Reidsville for 31 years and had recently retired.
Luking was the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 26 in 2024, when incumbent Phil Berger (R) defeated him 54.1% to 41.1%.
He advanced to the 2026 general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
In the 2024 survey, he listed public education funding and Medicaid coverage among his main concerns.
